summary: First-party research verified Myanmar national SLRD and Survey Department pointers, but no Myitkyina-local public parcel viewer/API or safe parcel geometry was obtained. SLRD direct access returned a Cloudflare challenge; general Survey Department pages describe topographic mapping only. This is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
queryOutcomes: English and Burmese discovery queries are recorded in city-2909-myitkyina.json with actual first-party result URLs. Results establish national agency pointers and general surveying material, not a local Myitkyina registry or parcel service.
requestOutcomes: Five routes were recorded: SLRD direct GET returned HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge; government directory, Survey Department landing/page, and Ministry page were reviewed as HTTP-200 first-party HTML evidence. No credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, private tokens, unsafe fields, parcel IDs, or geometry were requested or retained.
scopeLimits: National SLRD custody is not treated as local Myitkyina registry evidence; registryFound remains null.
No public parcel API, viewer configuration, schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity, or bounded geometry response was verified.
No exact WUP-point hit or miss was obtained; the exact point remains [25.3870777827219, 97.3912175243089] in latitude/longitude order.
Cloudflare challenge, general-agency pages, and an unrelated Myitkyina agricultural page are access/scope limitations, not citywide absence evidence.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter.
excludedFields: tax/account/registration details beyond a safe native parcel ID
credentials, private tokens and personal data
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created. A future retained sample must contain exactly one stable native ID in properties and keep source field mapping in this review.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No usable public parcel geometry service was reached. No hit/miss inference was made.
